answer: Each agent identity is bound to a TPM/SGX enclave and a zero-knowledge attestation of its code and nonce; ripple is the append-only identity state tree, knoll the hash anchor, and walnut the consensus contract. Forging requires compromising distinct physical enclaves and producing valid quotes, while admission follows an O(N^2) bonding curve; equivocation or duplicate proofs irreversibly slash collateral.
